summary: Full backend + frontend test of N-Security InfraManager. Backend 12/12 pytest passing. Frontend all critical flows verified on mobile viewport 390x844: login/wrong-password, clients CRUD, quotes (client select, add item, total, save→/quote/<id>), rack builder (48U, empty→switch48→slot render), topology (auto-generate 14 nodes, edit node), floor plan (draw mode, room, point, save), servers (create, check-all→online, reveal-toggle→spec-host), devices (create notebook + specs + preventive_months, add corrective+preventive, history cards, 'Última realizada' updated, show-qr, print-label present, device-edit prefilled), scan (asset tag navigates to detail, unknown code shows scan-error), dashboard metric-devices→devices tab, device-search filter. Applied 1 backend fix (Maintenance.device_id made Optional since backend already overrides it from URL path; previous schema caused all POST /devices/{id}/maintenances from frontend to fail with 422). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: Frontend does not send device_id in POST body; backend MaintenanceModel required device_id, returning 422. Made device_id Optional in backend/server.py (endpoint already overrides device_id from URL param). Verified: add-corrective + add-preventive now return 200 and update device.last_preventive.

action_items: Optional hardening: also update frontend addMaint mutation to send device_id explicitly so the payload matches the schema exactly (currently works because backend overrides from URL, but keeping both is safer).
Minor UX: on Dashboard metric-clients / metric-racks / metric-servers, verify similar deep links (only metric-devices was tested).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py MaintenanceModel.device_id was required but always overridden server-side (line 708). Now Optional — safer contract.
backend/server.py uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown which is deprecated in FastAPI (should migrate to lifespan). Non-blocking.
All React Native components correctly use View/Text/TouchableOpacity via ui.tsx wrapper; StyleSheet used through makeStyles. testIDs are consistently applied across screens.
seed_data_creation: Created and left in DB for the admin user during testing: TEST_UI_Client (client), 1 quote (300 total), TEST_Rack_UI (rack), TEST_Topo_UI (topology), TEST_FP_UI (floorplan), TEST_Server_UI (server, Manaus), 1 device TEST_ReTest with corrective+preventive maintenance history. Backend pytest data uses TEST_ prefix and cleans up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://vendor-rack-plan.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All tabs are file-routed under app/(tabs)/ — direct navigation to /quotes, /infra, /map, /devices works. Sheets are RN Modals — closing via data-testid=sheet-close or by clicking outside. Frontend now works end-to-end after backend fix in MaintenanceModel. No deprecated packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).
rca_of_issue: RCA — Maintenance 422: Pydantic model MaintenanceModel declared device_id as required string. Frontend addMaint mutation sends only {kind, description, technician, parts, date, cost} without device_id, so Pydantic validation returned 422 before the endpoint could inject device_id from the URL. Fix: make device_id Optional[str] = '' in MaintenanceModel; endpoint continues to set doc['device_id'] = item_id from path. Reproduction: POST /api/devices/{id}/maintenances with body missing device_id returned 422 before fix, 200 after.
